title: bga-mcp acceptance-to-evidence map
description: Maps each literal acceptance case of a backlog item to the installed-package assertion that proves it, or records that nothing does yet. Checked by `pnpm verify:acceptance-map`.

item.description: The backlog item whose acceptance criterion this case comes from.

case.description: The acceptance criterion, in the words the backlog uses.

boundary.description: packaged: proven through the installed server by a tests/e2e assertion. repository: proven by a gate over the repository itself, such as fixture integrity.

missing.description: Why nothing proves this case yet. The gate counts these; it does not accept them as evidence.
